robots_policy.retailers: hard gate on robots.txt, fails closed when unreachable

exempt_open_data_sources.open_food_facts: documented public v2 API (world.openfoodfacts.org) with a published ODbL licence and published rate limits
exempt_open_data_sources.open_prices: documented REST API at /api/v1/prices, the same project as Open Food Facts, published CC BY-SA terms
exempt_open_data_sources.osm_overpass: Overpass is a documented public API intended for exactly this kind of query; OSM data is ODbL
exempt_open_data_sources.plz_geocoord: static CSV served from a public code repository; Apache-2.0 verified from the repository's own LICENSE file
exempt_open_data_sources.nominatim: documented geocoding API with a published usage policy; the 1-request-per-second limit is observed in the request delay
exempt_open_data_sources.smard: official Bundesnetzagentur API with a published OpenAPI description

robots_policy.note: An exemption means a published licence and a documented API already settle the question, so no request is spent fetching a robots.txt. It is not permission to redistribute retailer data.

probes.name: Open Food Facts
probes.product_data: VERIFIED - full product records incl. name, brand, quantity, categories
probes.price_data: NOT AVAILABLE - Open Food Facts does not hold prices
probes.gtin: VERIFIED - barcodes are the primary key of the database
probes.licence: ODbL 1.0 (product data), CC0 for some structural metadata. Reported as stated by the project; not independently re-read in this phase.
probes.commercial_reuse: PERMITTED with obligations - ODbL requires attribution and share-alike for derived databases. This is a real constraint, not a free pass.
probes.rate_limits: 10 req/min for product search, 100 req/min for reads (per project docs)
probes.coverage: global, uneven by country; Germany is well covered
probes.access_test_detail: status=1; code=3017620422003; name='Nutella'; brands='Nutella, Ferrero'; quantity='400 g e'
probes.notes: Strong product identity, no price, no store. Useful as the cross-chain matching backbone, not as a price source.

probes.name: Open Prices
probes.product_data: PARTIAL - keyed by GTIN, product detail comes from Open Food Facts
probes.price_data: VERIFIED IN PHASE 1 - price, currency, date, location, type
probes.store_data: PARTIAL - location is free-text/OSM key, not a store registry
probes.gtin: VERIFIED IN PHASE 1 - GTIN is the join key
probes.historical_prices: VERIFIED IN PHASE 1 - this is a time series by design
probes.geography: crowdsourced, Europe-weighted; Germany reported well covered
probes.licence: CC BY-SA 3.0 reported by the project. NOT independently re-verified in Phase 3, because the licence page could not be located from the public documentation site without guessing URLs.
probes.commercial_reuse: REPORTED PERMITTED with attribution and share-alike; unverified in Phase 3
probes.api_available: VERIFIED - REST API at /api/v1/prices, JSON, paginated
probes.coverage: live API total is 318982 observations. Phase 1 measured 318,731, so the dataset has grown and the Phase 1 figure is consistent, not contradicted. Coverage across the six target chains was not re-measured in Phase 3.
probes.freshness: crowdsourced; Phase 1 measured the export in 2026-09
probes.access_test_detail: JSON API reachable at https://prices.openfoodfacts.org/api/v1/prices?limit=2; total_observations=318982; pages=31899; page_size=10; rows_in_page=10
probes.notes: Most attractive open source on licence grounds, and the API does work. Its weakness is coverage, not access: too few cross-chain overlaps to price a six-way basket, and no GTIN-equivalent is published by the retailers that would make a real-time feed possible. Do not treat it as a real-time price source.

probes.name: OpenStreetMap / Overpass
probes.store_data: VERIFIED - shop nodes/ways with name, brand, address tags, opening hours
probes.geography: global, very uneven; good in cities, poor in rural areas
probes.api_available: YES - Overpass QL, plus a full planet extract
probes.rate_limits: public instances are shared and often return 504 under load
probes.coverage: Phase 2 measured 123 grocery features in a Rostock box and 110 in Berlin, with addr:postcode present ~75% of the time. A nationwide name-filter count of 21,523 is NOT a store count.
probes.notes: The fallback store source for the four chains that block us. Cannot give prices. Completeness must be reported as a confidence, not assumed.

probes.name: plz_geocoord (WZB Social Science Center)
probes.licence: VERIFIED FROM PRIMARY SOURCE - Apache License 2.0
probes.commercial_reuse: PERMITTED - Apache-2.0 allows commercial reuse with attribution and requires notice of changes
probes.api_available: no API; a static CSV is the intended usage
probes.notes: Solves the postcode-to-coordinate step. Limitation: a postcode centroid can be several km from the actual store, so retailer-published coordinates are strictly better where available. Aldi Nord publishes lat/lng directly, so this source is a fallback, not a dependency.

probes.name: Nominatim (OpenStreetMap geocoding)
probes.licence: ODbL 1.0 (data); the service has its own usage policy
probes.commercial_reuse: DATA permitted with attribution; the public endpoint is for low-volume use only
probes.rate_limits: MAX 1 request per second, absolute maximum, no bulk geocoding
probes.coverage: good for addresses, poor for store entities
probes.access_test_detail: results=1 display='18119, Warnemünde, Ortsbeirat 1 : Diedrichshagen, Seebad Warnemünde, Rostock, Mecklenburg-Vorpommern, Deutschland'
probes.notes: Tested only to confirm the service answers. Not needed for this project now that plz_geocoord covers postcodes offline and retailers expose real coordinates.

probes.name: SMARD (Bundesnetzagentur, wholesale energy prices)
probes.data_type: official day-ahead wholesale price time series
probes.product_data: NOT AVAILABLE - this is electricity/gas, not groceries
probes.price_data: VERIFIED - day-ahead €/MWh series, but for energy not food
probes.licence: UNKNOWN - Phase 2 could not confirm it from the primary source. Secondary sources describe CC BY 4.0 but that is not evidence.
probes.rate_limits: not documented in the parts read
probes.notes: Not a grocery source. Relevant only to the electricity component of travel cost. Blocked on licence confirmation, and the `filter` parameter is a numeric module ID that was not resolved in Phase 2.
